payload.content: Before writing the SQL, walk through the problem in three labeled steps: Step 1 understand what the question asks, Step 2 identify the schema columns and tables involved, Step 3 derive the SQL. Write each step as a separate sentence.
Place the three labeled steps in the `breakdown` field. The `sql_query` field must contain only the final SQL with no preamble or narration.

payload.name: breakdown
payload.description: Three labeled steps (Step 1/2/3) before the SQL.

rationale: Adapter of tabfact's vi_step_decomposition mechanism (proven +0.120 on temporal-yes) to spider SQL — tests whether explicit Step-1/2/3 enumeration lifts spider when forced into a structural format.
